meta.source: NKDA_Smart DCR_User Manual_Version 3.0 (Vinzas Solutions India Pvt Ltd)
meta.scope: Pre-Check only (geometry/format compliance). No building-rule scrutiny.
meta.note: Values copied as written in the manual, including typos. Fields marked assumption or fromExample are NOT stated in the manual text and must be confirmed.

settings.colorModeNote: Decision A: only a colour (ACI 1-255) set directly on the object counts. ByLayer (256), ByBlock (0) and true-colour (RGB) objects are errors.
settings.caseNoteAssumption: Manual does not state case rules. AutoCAD layer names are case-insensitive; text lists are shown in capitals. Assumed case-insensitive.
settings.forbiddenNote: Blocks, Regions, Wipeouts, External references, OLE objects and MTEXT are not allowed in FLOOR layers. 3D polylines are not supported.
settings.unlistedNoteAssumption: ARC, CIRCLE, HATCH, SPLINE etc. in FLOOR layers are not addressed by the manual. Reported as warnings.
settings.closedNoteAssumption: Manual says Pre-Check verifies closed polylines. Applied to every 'Polyline' rule below unless the rule sets closed to null.

boundingRectangle.noteAssumption: Manual 3.1.1 (bounding rectangle at 0,0,0) and rule SITE-15 (Outermost Sheet Boundary, colour 61) are treated as the same rectangle.

settings.floorObjectsAllowedOnGroundNote: Confirmed by the user: floor-area objects (FLR-xx) go on the applicable numbered floor layer (FLOOR01, FLOOR02...). FLOOR-GROUND is reserved for common site-related details.

mandatory.name: At least one floor area polyline (colours 181, 6, 134, 122 or 33)

mandatoryNote: The manual lists 'Mandatory requirements' as a Pre-Check error class but does not say which items are mandatory. These three are my assumption. Edit this list to change them.

patterns.meaning: Proposed floor layer: FLOOR01, FLOOR02, ... (Applicable floor layer)
Named in 3.1.1.1 as alternative to FLOOR-GROUND for common site details
Intermediate terrace levels (manual v3.0): FLOOR-TERRACEINTERMEDIATE, FLOOR-TERRACEINTERMEDIATE 01, FLOOR-TERRACEINTERMEDIATE 02 ...
patterns.separatorNoteAssumption: The manual writes 'FLOOR-TERRACEINTERMEDIATE 01' with a space. A space, underscore or hyphen before the number is accepted.

patterns.meaning: Named in the heading of section 17.3 and in the 4.0 table heading
